patches.description: Apply macOS CAINFO restriction only to SecureTransport; retain CAINFO for OpenSSL and other backends.
Require explicit build-time preparation; never download dependencies while parsing.
Require explicit build-time compilation; never compile while parsing.
Require prepared parser tools before starting mapper subprocesses. Reject empty symbols before writing a map. Invalidate upstream symbol caches with schema version 12.
Retain text parsing; remove repository setter, SVN repository parsing and synthetic repository data loading.
Remove unused repository-backed binary conversion; retain wire constants and model fields.
Retain in-memory/text patch exports and blob callbacks; remove disk/tar and Conduit client loading. Avoid strlen(null) deprecation without changing null-path exports.
Do not run retained upstream testing base classes as an upstream test suite.
Diagnose missing project runtime symbols and direct maintainers to the project map tool.
Direct maintainers to the project map rebuild tool.
Document project CA paths and the SecureTransport versus other TLS backend distinction.
Point CA troubleshooting at the project-owned runtime resources.
Point CA troubleshooting at the project-owned runtime resources.
Do not declare or xmap unnamed anonymous classes; retain parent and interface dependencies.
Retain anonymous class parent/interface/trait requirements without creating a loadable class symbol.
